fact: On 12 September 2024 AMS-IX reported peak traffic at the Djibouti Internet Exchange (now AMS-IX Djibouti) at four times the level a year earlier, driven by content delivery networks located at the exchange.
title: The Wingu Group's Partnership with AMS-IX in Djibouti is now live as the Djibouti Internet Exchange becomes AMS-IX Djibouti
